dimension_notes_summary.cross_module_architecture: Import graph is strictly unidirectional: main.tsx -> App.tsx -> components/ui/button.tsx, lib/utils.ts, assets/*
dimension_notes_summary.high_level_elegance: Project follows Vite + React + TypeScript standard template structure with shadcn/ui conventions (components/ui/, lib/)
dimension_notes_summary.convention_outlier: src/main.tsx imports use single quotes ('react', './App.tsx') while src/App.tsx uses double quotes ("react", "lucide-react") - sibling modules in the same directory with inconsistent quote style
dimension_notes_summary.error_consistency: Zero I/O boundaries across all 4 production files (479 LOC): no network calls, no file system access, no parse operations, no user input processing
dimension_notes_summary.naming_quality: All React components use PascalCase (App, Hero, Card, Button) — consistent with TypeScript/React conventions
dimension_notes_summary.abstraction_fitness: cn() utility in src/lib/utils.ts composes clsx and twMerge into a single call point — a standard shadcn/ui pattern that reduces boilerplate across all component files; classified as a pass-through wra
dimension_notes_summary.dependency_health: `radix-ui` (^1.6.0) is listed as a dependency in package.json but is never imported anywhere in the source code — the only Radix import is `@radix-ui/react-slot` which is also a separate direct depend
dimension_notes_summary.low_level_elegance: src/App.tsx:285-289 — scroll handler computes progress * (1 + n) twice (once for cover, once for the if condition) instead of storing the intermediate value in a local variable
dimension_notes_summary.mid_level_elegance: main.tsx → App.tsx handoff is a model of simplicity: single import, explicit StrictMode wrapper, one render call — minimal and unsurprising
dimension_notes_summary.test_strategy: Zero test files exist anywhere in the codebase - no __tests__ directories, no *.test.* or *.spec.* files found
dimension_notes_summary.api_surface_coherence: Public API exports 4 total symbols across 3 modules: `App` (default export, App.tsx), `Button` + `buttonVariants` (named exports, button.tsx), `cn` (named export, utils.ts) — minimal and focused
dimension_notes_summary.authorization_consistency: The codebase contains 4 production source files (App.tsx, main.tsx, components/ui/button.tsx, lib/utils.ts) and 1 CSS file — no API route handlers exist, no server-side code, no database access
dimension_notes_summary.ai_generated_debt: Zero comments exist in the codebase (comment ratio 0.0) — no risk of restating comments
dimension_notes_summary.incomplete_migration: All 4 production source files use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) — zero .js or .jsx files exist under src/
dimension_notes_summary.package_organization: Total production source files: 4 (App.tsx, main.tsx, lib/utils.ts, components/ui/button.tsx) — well under the <20 threshold where flat structure is appropriate
dimension_notes_summary.initialization_coupling: Zero import-time side effects: no DB connections, file I/O, or network calls at module scope in any of the 4 production files
dimension_notes_summary.design_coherence: App.tsx: 50 hardcoded hex colors used as Tailwind arbitrary values (text-[#2d8c47], bg-[#e54833]) while the scene.color field already partially drives colors, creating an inconsistent color strategy
dimension_notes_summary.contract_coherence: All functions (cn, Button, Hero, App, Card) rely on TypeScript inference for return types; no explicit return type annotation exists that could be a lie
dimension_notes_summary.logic_clarity: No identical if/else or ternary branches detected anywhere in the codebase
dimension_notes_summary.type_safety: tsconfig.app.json lacks 'strict: true' (and 'strictNullChecks'), allowing null/undefined to be silently assignable to all typed variables throughout the codebase

review_issue_summaries.summary: App.tsx (407 LOC) acts as a hub module combining scene data, Hero component, footer, and scroll-driven state management in a single file
README.md is the default Vite+React scaffold template and does not describe the TOB-I project, its architecture, setup, or deployment
Unused template boilerplate files (react.svg tracked, vite.svg and hero.png untracked) in src/assets/ have no consumers and pollute the asset directory
inspo/ directory at project root contains downloaded external webpage assets (Neobrutalism CSS inspiration files) that are non-production reference material
index.html loads Google Fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono, Outfit) that are never used by the application CSS — only DM Sans is configured
App.tsx at 407 LOC mixes scene data definitions, Card and Hero subcomponents, and layout orchestration in a single module, limiting decomposition clarity
Inconsistent quote style between sibling modules in src/: main.tsx uses single quotes while App.tsx uses double quotes
Namespace import for React in button.tsx while sibling modules use named imports creates an import style island
Mixed default and named export patterns: App.tsx uses default export while sibling modules use named exports
Unused `radix-ui` meta dependency — the project imports `@radix-ui/react-slot` directly and never references the umbrella `radix-ui` package
Duplicate computation of progress * (1 + n) in scroll handler
Hardcoded hex scene colors bypass CSS custom property design tokens
Dual-path styling: inline style props mixed with Tailwind utility classes in Hero component
App.tsx monolithic module conflates data, orchestration, state, and rendering with no internal seam boundaries
No error boundaries or lifecycle propagation patterns established across module seams
Scene data model tightly couples presentation (ReactNode) with data, eliminating data-translation boundaries
Core application component src/App.tsx (407 LOC) with complex scroll-driven state management has zero test coverage
Reusable Button component (src/components/ui/button.tsx) with 4 variants and 4 sizes has no unit tests
Entry point uses non-null assertion on getElementById, bypassing error contract for missing DOM element
50 hardcoded hex colors used inconsistently — some data-driven, others as Tailwind arbitrary values
Scene data structure embeds full JSX in leftPanel, rightPanel, and content fields, mixing data with presentation
Three near-identical scene panel render loops for left, center, and right panels in App.tsx
Three React components (Card, Hero, App) with distinct responsibilities defined in a single file
tsconfig.app.json is missing strict: true (and strictNullChecks), so null/undefined are silently assignable to all typed variables across the entire codebase
Exported default export App component lacks explicit return type annotation
Exported Button component lacks explicit return type annotation
Exported cn() utility function lacks explicit return type annotation
